description: Stage draft copies of pages in another language: copied as is, language set, linked to the original as a translation (menus not copied). Then translate the bodies, write them in one apply_changeset, and publish_site. Target path = language folder + source path unless an item sets `path`; an existing path is left untouched.

from.description: Copy from this translation's path instead of the main-language page.

lang.description: Language of the new pages, e.g. de or pt-BR.

paths.description: Source paths, or {from, path} to choose the new path.

name: translate_page
